disciplinary_grounds.description: No individual may take the exam while a complaint charging illegal practice of architecture is pending

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensed architect must not permit their name to be used with an unlicensed person in a way that indicates the other person is a licensed architect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No licensed architect shall permit his name to be used in connection with the name of any other person not licensed to practice architecture in this State in any advertisement, sign, card or device in such a manner as to indicate that such other person is a licensed architect.

insurance_required.quote: Any architect entering into a public contract for architectural services according to the provisions of chapter 34 of Title 52 of the Revised Statutes ... shall carry errors and omissions insurance.
